template_data.headline_html: Four screens before you pick a vehicle.

items.title: NAICS fit
items.desc: Does your primary code appear in the vehicle's scope? Not every code lives in every vehicle.

items.title: Minimum order floor
items.desc: SEWP has a $10K minimum. If your average engagement is $8K, that's the wrong rail.

items.title: Active buyer agencies
items.desc: GSA MAS is broad. SEWP is DoD/NASA IT-focused. Pick the vehicle your buyers already use.

items.title: On-ramp timeline
items.desc: GSA MAS: 6–12 months. SEWP: invitation-only. Know your cash flow window before you start.
